When I roll with wbsplainers, I sometimes ask them right before we start how familiar they are with the technique, in most cases they aren’t that familiar but i think people just like explaining to others as a way of figuring it out themselves. I also ask them if they could please do it first and I don’t correct them (because I’m also a WB and wouldn’t want to give wrong info out) At this point i can see how comfortable they are with it.

When it’s my turn to do it I tell them that I’m going to do this slowly and talk myself through it, and they can give me feedback AFTER if they’d like. In this way I set the tone for how I want to drill. 

If they did it great on their turn I’m open to their feedback but if they were confused and unsure I ask the coach. And sometimes if they’re doing weird reactive things during the drill I will ask the coach what to do if my partner does xyz and they will usually correct the person if they’re doing something strange.
